title: Module 7: Self-Healing Materials
description: Examine how biology-inspired repair strategies inform polymer, composite, and infrastructure materials that can respond to microscopic damage.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain how capsule-based self-healing materials work
Compare biological repair logic with engineering repair strategies
Evaluate when self-healing materials are worth the added cost and complexity

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
